title: No one left behind on the Expresso trail: fifteen years of Tuesday rides with Girls Outside

posts.facebook:
A women's mountain bike group near Aspen has ridden singletrack together for nearly 15 years. Its rule: no one left behind.

How a group of women in Colorado's Roaring Fork Valley turned a Tuesday mountain bike ride into a 15-year habit: the motto, the tailgate and why the group keeps them riding. How to start mountain biking on easy graded trails, or ride harder terrain with a group if you already ride.

A regular ride with people who wait for you is how a hard sport becomes a lasting habit.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/move/girls-outside-mountain-bike-rides/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
